issue.title: Feature request: built-in rotating file writer
issue.body:
It would be great if ctx-log shipped a `FileWriter` (ideally with size/daily rotation) so we don't have to implement `IWriter` ourselves for every service. zerolog users typically pair it with lumberjack; something similar as an optional writer would help.

Happy to send a PR if the API shape is agreed.

rationale: Clear feature request in writers area.
